collection.title: BMW 6 Series Gran Turismo 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW 6 Series Gran Turismo 2017 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
